{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check sample_seq per patient_id to see how many have multiple samples
sample_counts = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
duplicates_with_multiple_samples = sample_counts[sample_counts > 1].count()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (re-tested): {duplicates_with_multiple_samples}")"}
